create_gaussian_renderer: create a GaussianRenderer instance with custom height, width, background color, znear, and zfar parameters
render_gaussian_splats: render 3D Gaussian splats into RGB images and alpha masks using camera intrinsics and extrinsics
rasterize_gaussians_with_gsplat: rasterize Gaussian parameters including means, quaternions, scales, opacities, and colors using gsplat rasterization
render_with_custom_resolution: render Gaussian splats at a custom resolution by passing height and width arguments to the renderer call
invert_world_to_camera_matrices: invert world-to-camera transformation matrices using affine_inverse to compute camera view matrices for rendering
